title: Environmental Enrichment and Agonistic Behavior in Post-Weaning Pigs: A Pilot Study Using Artificial Intelligence.
summary: YOLOv8 object detection tracked pig behaviour in a pilot enrichment trial, enabling comparison of agonistic behaviour between enriched and control conditions.
ai_technology: YOLOv8 object detection tracked pig behaviour in a pilot enrichment trial, enabling comparison of agonistic behaviour between enriched and control conditions.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The detector reached mAP50 0.953; enrichment was associated with reduced agonistic behaviour in the pilot cohort, whose size and setting limit generalization.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
